## 2024-05-24 - [Optimize sorting by utilizing cached os.DirEntry stats]
**Learning:** Inside an `os.scandir()` loop, casting `os.DirEntry` to `pathlib.Path` before invoking `.stat()` causes redundant I/O syscalls because it discards the cached attributes within `os.DirEntry`. By sorting an array of `os.DirEntry` objects using `entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)` directly, we avoid this overhead and can see significant performance improvements (e.g. ~3x faster).
**Action:** When filtering or sorting items generated by `os.scandir()`, keep them as `os.DirEntry` objects as long as possible and rely on their native `stat()` caching instead of eagerly converting them to `Path` objects.
